title: M2: apricity export --sidecars writes an .asd beside each analyzed sample
description:
## Purpose
`apricity export --sidecars <audio or folder>…` writes an `.asd` beside every analyzed sample, so a sample dragged from the library into the DAW lands on the grid with no re-warping. (If M0 said **no-go** on writing `.asd`, the same command writes `<audio>.alc` beside the sample instead; the stories below then read ".alc" for ".asd".)

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A["samples/…/Thunderer.mp3
+ .apricity.json"] -->|apricity export --sidecars| B["Thunderer.mp3.asd
(markers, warp mode, detune)"]
  B --> C["the DAW's browser → track:
on the grid, no re-warp"]
  L["library: files/audio/smp_…/x.wav"] -->|--library L| B2["x.wav.asd beside the library copy
(never synced, never in git)"]
```

## Scope
- The `export` subcommand with a `--sidecars` mode (shared with apricitus-6edba8's `--daw-set`: whichever lands first adds `export`).
- File mode (`samples/` trees) and library mode (`--library`), `--dry-run`, `--force`.
- Protecting corrections made in the DAW: an existing sidecar whose markers differ from Apricity's grid is not overwritten.
- Sidecars are derived files: gitignored under `samples/`, excluded from `apricity sync`.

## Out of scope
Clip files per saved clip (M3); your own warp markers (M4: until then the grid is the analysis's); import (M5).

## Definition of Done
1. `features/daw/export_sidecars.feature` (+ STEPS.md rows), CLI-level runner `crates/apricity-cli/tests/daw_cli.rs`; a scenario added to `features/sync/sync.feature` for sidecars never syncing; all green.
2. Rust (`apricity-daw::export`, `apricity-cli`, `apricity-data::sync`). No Python.
3. No schema change.
4. CLI: flags, `--help` text, report lines, errors with file and reason.
5. Fixtures from M1; generated WAVs in temp dirs.
7. `docs/tools.md` "DAW sidecars" section; `docs/concepts.md` paragraph; glossary already has the words (M1).
8. Web need filed (label `web`).
9. `safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw -p apricity-cli -p apricity-data`; manual drag-in check in the DAW.
10, 11. Log; `feat(<task id>)`; nothing breaking.

## Dependencies
Blocked by M1. Relates to apricitus-6edba8 (`export` subcommand).
